scope: Full unchanged 66-file v4 union plus individually inspected English-stage additions and this manual checkpoint. Unrelated local files are not admitted.

inspection.inherited_review: Frozen v4 full-content review is retained; original manifest and allowlist anchors and every v4 working-byte binding are rechecked. No frozen manuscript or previous checkpoint was edited.
inspection.new_content: Every new source module, synthetic test, protocol, aggregate report, hash-only receipt and manuscript addendum was read completely before inclusion. Inputs in tests are authored fixtures; source code contains no selected speaker records.
inspection.limitation: Pattern checks supplement content review and cannot prove absence of arbitrary secrets.

scan.limitation: Credential-pattern scan supplements complete content inspection; it cannot guarantee the absence of arbitrary secrets.

source_consistency: All English Python entrypoint imports close relative to the fixed base plus the allowlist; existing tracked source dependencies remain unchanged. Scientific source snapshots and manifest gates remain distinct from Git packaging.

Original licensed ICSI transcript archive and frozen source policies/split material require separately permitted acquisition; no speaker dialogue or human review content is made public.
Official pinned Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 weights, publisher metadata/tokenizer and llama.cpp b11573 Windows CPU binaries/DLLs remain separate excluded assets.

Private pinned Jinja2/MarkupSafe rendering assets and exact historical absolute paths/source bytes may be required by original gates; relocation or line-ending normalization is not guaranteed to reproduce.

Genuine English reviews have been received but remain incompatible with the frozen schema/rubric and not finalized or condition-integrated. Code/tests cannot supply semantic validity or missing human judgments.
Independent English replication has zero qualified cases under the frozen source procedure. New legitimately qualified data/access is a scientific dependency, not repaired by this checkpoint.

preservation: Parent verified every source/member hash and size for1690 files in three private ZIPs, a separate three-file human-intake ZIP and an eight-file recovery ZIP. These are same-volume backups, not remote/off-device preservation or automatic backup of future human edits.
